raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

This speeds up the `kVecSize == 8` path in `sgl_per_token_quant_fp8`.

The existing `kVecSize == 16` path already used a packed `uint4` store, but the `kVecSize == 8` path fell back to element-wise FP8 stores. This PR adds a single `uint64_t` store for `kVecSize == 8`

## Benchmarks
| Shape | Before | After | Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `(4, 1024, 1368)` | `25.08 us` | `12.07 us` | `2.08x / 51.9%` |
| `(2, 1024, 1368)` | `10.38 us` | `9.38 us` | `1.11x / 9.6%` |
| `(4, 512, 1368)` | `10.40 us` | `9.41 us` | `1.10x / 9.5%` |
| `(4, 1024, 1076)` | `13.38 us` | `13.27 us` | `1.01x / 0.8%` |

Prefill `M=4096`:

| Shape | K | N | Quant Only Before | Quant Only After | Quant Only Speedup | Quant + Matmul Before | Quant + Matmul After | Quant + Matmul Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TinyLlama up/gate | 2048 | 5632 | `20.05 us` | `18.91 us` | `1.06x / 5.7%` | `693.0 us` | `690.5 us` | `1.00x / 0.4%` |
| Mistral/Llama-8B up/gate | 4096 | 14336 | `22.85 us` | `22.64 us` | `1.01x / 0.9%` | `2870.1 us` | `2867.6 us` | `1.00x / 0.1%` |

## Code Review

This pull request optimizes memory copying for a vector size of 8 in both `per_token_quant_fp8_kernel` and `per_token_quant_fp8_small_batch_kernel` by casting the output array to `uint64_t*` instead of using element-wise copies. The reviewer noted that casting `output_arr` to `uint64_t*` or `uint4*` can cause undefined behavior or alignment faults due to the 1-byte alignment of `DST_DTYPE`. They recommended aligning `output_arr` to 16 bytes using `alignas(16)` in both kernels to ensure safe memory access.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Casting `output_arr` to `uint64_t*` (and `uint4*` in the `kVecSize == 16` path) is undefined behavior because `output_arr` is declared as `DST_DTYPE output_arr[kVecSize];`. Since `DST_DTYPE` (`__nv_fp8_e4m3`) is a 1-byte type, `output_arr` is only guaranteed to be 1-byte aligned. On some GPU architectures or compiler versions, accessing unaligned memory via casted pointers can lead to alignment faults, incorrect code generation, or performance penalties.

To resolve this, please ensure `output_arr` is aligned to 16 bytes by updating its declaration at line 99:
```cpp
alignas(16) DST_DTYPE output_arr[kVecSize];
```

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Since `DST_DTYPE` (`__nv_fp8_e4m3`) is a 1-byte type, `output_arr` is only guaranteed to be 1-byte aligned. On some GPU architectures or compiler versions, accessing unaligned memory via casted pointers can lead to alignment faults, incorrect code generation, or performance penalties.

To resolve this, please ensure `output_arr` is aligned to 16 bytes by updating its declaration at line 177:
```cpp
alignas(16) DST_DTYPE output_arr[kVecSize];
```

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep vec8 stores from assuming 8-byte output alignment**

When `output_q` is a contiguous FP8 view with a non-zero byte storage offset, `CHECK_INPUT(output_q)` still accepts it, but this casts the byte-addressed FP8 pointer to `uint64_t*` and emits a naturally aligned 8-byte store. For `hidden_dim % 8 == 0 && hidden_dim % 16 != 0`, such an output can be only byte-aligned, so the vec8 path can perform misaligned 64-bit global stores and corrupt/fault where the previous element-wise writes were safe; the identical vec8 store in the small-batch kernel needs the same guard or fallback.
